literature_notes: All three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) describe a single construct: 'full-length human CD31-GFP', a C-terminal GFP fusion to PECAM-1. The C-terminus of PECAM-1 (residue 738, T) falls within the intracellular domain (residues 621–738), so the GFP tag is on the cytoplasmic face. The construct confirms that the full-length protein traffics to the cell surface and is functional (CPB susceptibility restored; oligomer formation in HEK293 cells), but the tag itself is not extracellular. No ledger line describes a tag inserted at the extracellular N-terminus (after residue 27, the signal-peptide cleavage site), in any extracellular loop, or at any other extracellular position. Because the sole evidence is for an intracellular C-terminal fusion, zero extracellular surface-tag sites are supported by the ledger.

literature_other_positions.note: Full-length CD31-GFP is a C-terminal GFP fusion; residue 738 (T) is the last residue of the intracellular domain (621–738), so the tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
